label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Segment Your Email List
body: Send more relevant messages by grouping your subscribers based on their interests or past purchases.
caption:
Think about your audience groups. Do some buy your art, while others prefer your workshops? Are some new, and others long-time fans? Sending emails tailored to these different groups can make your messages feel more personal and helpful. It helps people see content that matters most to them. Give it a try and see how your readers respond! 👋
